_comment: Flag fragments for a launch script that starts the nodes itself (the controller builds these flags from --slots and --spec-draft instead). The script appends these to EVERY node's command ('slots' with {n} = the launch's slots) and passes --max-batch-size N itself, which the nodes also read as the slot count. 'draft' values are used verbatim (no {path} expansion): give the draft model folder as it is on node 0's host.
